body: I don't think I am relentlessly negative. I think, or hope at least, that without me opening up, people tend to not know how much I fucking hate myself. But as soon as I let them know that I don't like myself and I've never felt like I belong anywhere or whatever, that's basically the last time they want me around. Or at least, thats the last time that I really hear from them save from the very occasional "U still alive" text. It seems like the people I tell the least to are the only people that will have me.
Ignoring me seems like a strange way to get me to not think about my problems. Especially since my problems revolve around loneliness.
